messages:
Maya: Quick design review — I pushed a new Figma file for the compact roles matrix + bulk-invite modal: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/roles-invite. Primary asks: microcopy tweaks, keyboard-nav behavior, and audit-log context. Please focus on edge cases (mobile collapse, partial CSV failures).

Ashwin: Dropped an a11y pass on Figma. Main changes: role chips collapse to '3+' on narrow widths and a tooltip shows the full list. Question: when collapsed, should the collapsed entry be keyboard-selectable to open the list? :thinking_face:

Samira: Yes — collapsed entry must be keyboard-focusable. Implementation idea: make chips actual <button> elements and the collapsed state an aria-expanded toggle that reveals a list. Avoid nested buttons inside the list to keep semantics simple.

Zach: SSO toggle copy — current options ('Require SSO for new members' / 'Enforce SSO for org') are confusing. Suggest 'Require SSO for all sign-ins' with a short helper: "Requires SSO for every login; service accounts may be exempt." Also we need an explicit row about service-account exemptions in the settings panel.

Claire: CSV microcopy suggestion: use header 'email,roles,expiry' (friendly) instead of 'emails,roles,expires_at' (devy). Also propose showing a small example sample file link in the modal. If a row omits roles, default to 'Viewer' — should we show the default mapping in the UI before upload?

Maya: Good call on defaults — yes, show default mapping preview below the upload area. UX preference: when bulk-invite has partial failures, surface inline row errors with a 'retry row' action next to each failed row rather than a blocking modal. Keeps flow lightweight.

Ashwin: Accessibility nit: current purple role badge only hits ~3.2:1 contrast on the gray backdrop. Options: darken badge text to #5B3E96 or add a 2px white outline for legibility. Also make sure focus rings are always visible even when users enable reduced motion.

Samira: Note on audit log pagination — backend currently provides cursor tokens only. Product asks for page numbers for admin mental model. Implementable compromise: keep cursor-based pagination for performance but surface 'Previous / Next' with an optional 'Jump to date' input that issues a server-side seek. Page numbers would be expensive to support reliably.

Zach: Audit log entries need richer context lines: show actor + verb + object, e.g., 'Alice removed deploy-key from repo-x' instead of a generic 'role change'. Also include a quick link to the user and the affected resource. That helps triage.

Claire: Invite drawer behavior: Esc should close the drawer but preserve unsent emails in local state so the user doesn't lose typed invites. Proposal: persist draft invites to localStorage for 1 hour and clear on explicit success/cancel. Thoughts?

Maya: +1 to local persistence for 1 hour. I'll update the Figma frames to include the CSV sample, the inline row-error pattern, and SSO helper copy. Tagging @Ashwin and @Samira for final sign-off on accessibility and technical feasibility. :thumbsup:

design-bot: Added Design QA checklist to this thread (contrast, keyboard nav, ARIA labels, CSV sample). Checklist: https://intranet.redwood.design/qa/123.
